en.headline: Food Expo and concurrent shows draw record 520,000 visitors
en.dek: The five HKTDC events that closed on Monday attracted more than 520,000 public visitors and average spending of HK$1,685, both all-time highs.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council said the Food Expo, Beauty & Wellness Expo and Home Delights Expo, which ended on Monday, together with the earlier Food Expo (Trade) and Hong Kong International Tea Fair, drew more than 520,000 public visitors, a record for the series.

More than 1,850 exhibitors from over 30 countries and regions took part. A random survey of more than 1,430 visitors found average spending reached HK$1,685, also a new high, with 87 per cent saying actual spending matched or exceeded their budget.

The trade fairs attracted about 20,000 buyers from 64 countries and regions. HKTDC said the results reflected continued demand for quality food, health products and lifestyle goods, and reinforced Hong Kong’s role as a food-trading hub.

zh.headline: 美食博覽及同期展覽入場逾52萬人次創紀錄
zh.dek: 貿發局五項展覽周一結束，公眾入場人次逾52萬、人均消費1,685元，均創歷屆新高，反映本地消費保持活力。
body: 香港貿易發展局表示，美食博覽、美與健生活博覽及家電家居博覽於周一圓滿結束，連同較早閉幕的美食商貿博覽及香港國際茶展，五項展覽共吸引逾52萬公眾人次入場，打破歷屆紀錄。
展覽匯聚來自超過30個國家及地區逾1,850家展商。大會隨機訪問逾1,430名入場人士，人均消費達1,685港元，同樣創新高，87%受訪者表示實際消費與預算相若或高於預算。
商貿展覽吸引約20,000名來自64個國家及地區的買家。貿發局指，結果反映市場對優質食品、健康產品及生活用品需求殷切，並鞏固香港作為食品貿易樞紐的角色。
